author: ojiudezue
title: OC live eval uncorked with an ADMIN HA token (logs choice B); read-only now rests on the harness client alone
summary: Operator chose log access, so the oc_eval keychain token is admin. Harness reads it from the keychain at runtime, never exposes it to the model, scrubs it, fails closed. Read-only is enforced by GET-only allowlisted REST, ssh -readonly SQL, a write interceptor and an egress allowlist test with mutation drills (all red on mutation). Also: forecast input CSV untracked from the public repo (no history rewrite).
why: Logs are the evidence for several eval cases; the non-admin user the plan assumed could not read them. The trade is a larger blast radius if the client allowlist were bypassed, accepted because D5 tests make any write path fail the suite. CSV untracked because it is a household usage pattern in a public repo.
implications: Plan §9 safety must record the admin-token assumption. Case evidence expires 11-04 (L03) and 11-06 (L02, L08), so dev and full rounds are time-boxed.
revisit_trigger: Any new tool added to the eval REGISTRY, or the eval moving toward production agent runs: switch to a scoped non-admin token first.
